tools.name: light_remote_connection_helper
tools.title: Connect Light Remote with A/B approval
tools.description: Start here. Handles Local Wall A/B pairing and, when ready, returns/reuses the working context plus a compact tool-family menu. Call again with helperGroup=workspace|files|shell|transfer|desktop only when detailed syntax for that family is needed. OAuth account login alone never authorizes a device.

tools.name: light_remote_list_devices
tools.title: List A/B-authorized Light Remote devices
tools.description: List only devices that this plugin client has explicitly paired through Local Wall A/B approval. Targeting remains explicit; no silent fallback.

tools.name: light_remote_context
tools.title: Recover or change the working Light Remote context
tools.description: Reuse or create the durable working session for one A/B-authorized device, optionally changing workspace or grace. Never silently switches to an unauthorized target.

tools.name: light_remote_inspect_device
tools.title: Inspect a Light Remote device
tools.description: Read policy, connection, routing, Main/Fleet, update and capability state for one owned device.

tools.name: light_remote_recent_activity
tools.title: Read recent device activity
tools.description: Read a sanitized recent activity view for one owned device.

tools.name: light_remote_set_main_device
tools.title: Set the Main device
tools.description: Select an owned online device as Main and move current Fleet authority to it.

tools.name: light_remote_revoke_device
tools.title: Revoke a device
tools.description: Revoke remote authority for an owned non-integrated device. Requires explicit user intent.

tools.name: light_remote_remove_device
tools.title: Remove a device
tools.description: Permanently remove an owned device enrollment record. Re-enrollment requires local A/B approval again.

tools.name: light_remote_open_session
tools.title: Open or reuse a durable session
tools.description: Bind work to one explicit owned device and this MCP client.

tools.name: light_remote_list_sessions
tools.title: List durable sessions
tools.description: List account-scoped sessions owned by this MCP connection for recovery and continuation. Supply sessionId to read one exact session.

tools.name: light_remote_session_control
tools.title: Resume a durable session
tools.description: Resume one existing durable session that is on hold. This changes session state but does not switch devices or authorize a new target.

tools.name: light_remote_hold_session
tools.title: Hold a durable session
tools.description: Place one existing durable session on hold during an intentional transport interruption. The session can be resumed later.

tools.name: light_remote_close_session
tools.title: Close a durable session
tools.description: Close one session after work is complete.

tools.name: light_remote_list_files
tools.title: List remote files
tools.description: List an allowed directory on the selected session target.

tools.name: light_remote_read_file
tools.title: Read a remote text file
tools.description: Read a bounded text range from an allowed path.

tools.name: light_remote_search_files
tools.title: Start a remote file search
tools.description: Start one bounded file-name or text-content search inside an allowed path on the selected device. Use the returned search identifier with the results tool.

tools.name: light_remote_search_results
tools.title: Read remote search results
tools.description: Read a bounded page of results from an existing remote file search without changing files.

tools.name: light_remote_cancel_search
tools.title: Cancel a remote file search
tools.description: Cancel one in-progress remote file search. This stops that search job but does not modify user files.

tools.name: light_remote_read_multiple_files
tools.title: Read multiple remote text files
tools.description: Read bounded text from multiple allowed files in one structured read-only operation.

tools.name: light_remote_stat_path
tools.title: Stat a remote path
tools.description: Read bounded metadata for one allowed path without requiring write scope.

tools.name: light_remote_filesystem
tools.title: Create a remote directory
tools.description: Create one directory inside the device allowed roots. Local device policy remains the final authorization boundary.

tools.name: light_remote_copy_path
tools.title: Copy a remote filesystem path
tools.description: Copy one allowed file or directory to another allowed path. Overwrite can replace destination data when explicitly requested.

tools.name: light_remote_move_path
tools.title: Move a remote filesystem path
tools.description: Move or rename one allowed file or directory. The source path is removed as part of the move.

tools.name: light_remote_delete_path
tools.title: Delete a remote filesystem path
tools.description: Delete one allowed file or directory. Recursive deletion must be explicitly requested and can be irreversible.

tools.name: light_remote_write_file
tools.title: Write a remote text file
tools.description: Rewrite or append text on an allowed path.

tools.name: light_remote_edit_file
tools.title: Edit an exact remote text block
tools.description: Replace an exact text block and fail if the expected replacement count is not met.

tools.name: light_remote_exec
tools.title: Execute one bounded remote command job
tools.description: Run one logical shell/PowerShell job. Prefer structured tools first; device policy re-infers capabilities before spawn.

tools.name: light_remote_process
tools.title: Start a managed remote process
tools.description: Start one persistent non-PTY process on the selected device. The command may change local or external state according to the script and device policy.

tools.name: light_remote_process_input
tools.title: Send input to a managed process
tools.description: Send bounded stdin data to one existing managed process. Input can cause the process to change local or external state.

tools.name: light_remote_process_output
tools.title: Read managed process output
tools.description: Read a bounded stdout or stderr range from one existing managed process without changing the process.

tools.name: light_remote_list_processes
tools.title: List managed remote processes
tools.description: List managed non-PTY processes owned by the current Light Remote session without changing them.

tools.name: light_remote_stop_process
tools.title: Stop a managed remote process
tools.description: Stop one managed process. Force mode may terminate it immediately and can discard in-process work.

tools.name: light_remote_terminal
tools.title: Start a remote PTY or ConPTY terminal
tools.description: Start one interactive terminal session on the selected device. Starting the terminal changes session state but does not itself execute user commands.

tools.name: light_remote_terminal_input
tools.title: Send input to a remote terminal
tools.description: Send bounded text or control input to one existing PTY/ConPTY terminal. Input can execute commands that change local or external state.

tools.name: light_remote_terminal_output
tools.title: Read remote terminal output
tools.description: Read a bounded output range from one existing PTY/ConPTY terminal without sending input.

tools.name: light_remote_resize_terminal
tools.title: Resize a remote terminal
tools.description: Change the rows and columns of one existing PTY/ConPTY terminal without executing a command.

tools.name: light_remote_signal_terminal
tools.title: Signal a remote terminal process
tools.description: Send interrupt, terminate, or kill to the process group owned by one terminal. Terminate or kill can discard running work.

tools.name: light_remote_list_terminals
tools.title: List remote terminals
tools.description: List PTY/ConPTY terminals owned by the current Light Remote session without changing them.

tools.name: light_remote_stop_terminal
tools.title: Stop a remote terminal
tools.description: Stop one PTY/ConPTY terminal. Force mode may terminate its process group immediately and can discard running work.

tools.name: light_remote_scp_download
tools.title: Begin a large or binary file download
tools.description: Begin one resumable Light SCP download from an allowed remote path and return transfer metadata with SHA-256 integrity information.

tools.name: light_remote_scp_download_chunk
tools.title: Read a download chunk
tools.description: Read one indexed chunk from an existing Light SCP download without changing the source file.

tools.name: light_remote_scp_download_status
tools.title: Read download status
tools.description: Read status and integrity metadata for one existing Light SCP download.

tools.name: light_remote_scp_download_cancel
tools.title: Cancel a file download
tools.description: Cancel one in-progress Light SCP download and discard its transfer state without modifying the remote source file.

tools.name: light_remote_scp
tools.title: Begin a large or binary file upload
tools.description: Begin one resumable Light SCP upload to an allowed destination. Data is staged until commit and integrity is verified with SHA-256.

tools.name: light_remote_scp_upload_chunk
tools.title: Write an upload chunk
tools.description: Stage one indexed data chunk for an existing Light SCP upload. This changes transfer state but does not commit the destination file.

tools.name: light_remote_scp_upload_commit
tools.title: Commit a file upload
tools.description: Verify and commit one completed Light SCP upload to its destination. If overwrite was requested, existing destination data can be replaced.

tools.name: light_remote_scp_upload_status
tools.title: Read upload status
tools.description: Read status and integrity metadata for one existing Light SCP upload.

tools.name: light_remote_scp_upload_cancel
tools.title: Cancel a file upload
tools.description: Cancel one in-progress Light SCP upload and discard staged transfer data before commit.

tools.name: light_remote_desktop
tools.title: Read remote desktop status
tools.description: Read Real Remote V2 desktop session status for the selected Light Remote session without attaching or sending input.

tools.name: light_remote_desktop_attach
tools.title: Attach remote desktop observation
tools.description: Attach a bounded Real Remote V2 desktop observation session. This creates observation state but does not send keyboard or pointer input.

tools.name: light_remote_desktop_resume
tools.title: Resume remote desktop observation
tools.description: Resume one existing Real Remote V2 desktop observation session without sending user input.

tools.name: light_remote_desktop_detach
tools.title: Detach remote desktop observation
tools.description: Detach one existing Real Remote V2 desktop observation session. This stops observation state and does not alter desktop content.

tools.name: light_remote_desktop_windows
tools.title: List remote desktop windows
tools.description: Read the visible window inventory from the authorized remote desktop without sending input.

tools.name: light_remote_desktop_frame
tools.title: Read a remote desktop frame
tools.description: Read one bounded desktop frame for bootstrap or resynchronization without sending keyboard or pointer input.

tools.name: light_remote_desktop_observe
tools.title: Observe remote desktop state
tools.description: Read one bounded Real Remote V2 observation from an authorized desktop without sending input.

tools.name: light_remote_semantic_attach
tools.title: Attach semantic desktop observation
tools.description: Attach a bounded semantic desktop provider for structured UI observation. This creates observation state and does not send input.

tools.name: light_remote_semantic_snapshot
tools.title: Read a semantic desktop snapshot
tools.description: Read one structured semantic UI snapshot from an existing authorized semantic observation session.

tools.name: light_remote_semantic_events
tools.title: Read semantic desktop events
tools.description: Read bounded semantic UI events after a sequence number without changing the remote desktop.

tools.name: light_remote_semantic_detach
tools.title: Detach semantic desktop observation
tools.description: Detach one semantic observation session. This stops observation state and does not alter desktop content.

tools.name: light_remote_desktop_live_open
tools.title: Open live semantic desktop observation
tools.description: Open a bounded live semantic observation lane for an authorized desktop. This creates observation state and sends no keyboard or pointer input.

tools.name: light_remote_desktop_live_close
tools.title: Close live semantic desktop observation
tools.description: Close one live semantic observation lane. This stops observation state and does not alter desktop content.

tools.name: light_remote_desktop_live_read
tools.title: Read buffered Real Remote V2 live state
tools.description: Read already-buffered semantic deltas/snapshot from the Hub cache without dispatching a new Windows observation job.

tools.name: light_remote_semantic_invoke
tools.title: Desktop semantic invoke
tools.description: Press a named semantic UI control. This tool performs only this named operation. Optional await observes one declared UI state after the action. Device-local approval remains mandatory.

tools.name: light_remote_semantic_click
tools.title: Desktop semantic click
tools.description: Click a named semantic UI control. This tool performs only this named operation. Optional await observes one declared UI state after the action. Device-local approval remains mandatory.

tools.name: light_remote_semantic_focus
tools.title: Desktop semantic focus
tools.description: Focus a named semantic UI element. This tool performs only this named operation. Optional await observes one declared UI state after the action. Device-local approval remains mandatory.

tools.name: light_remote_semantic_value
tools.title: Desktop semantic value
tools.description: Set the text value of a named semantic UI element. This tool performs only this named operation. Optional await observes one declared UI state after the action. Device-local approval remains mandatory.

tools.name: light_remote_semantic_toggle
tools.title: Desktop semantic toggle
tools.description: Toggle a named semantic checkbox or switch (Windows UIA). This tool performs only this named operation. Optional await observes one declared UI state after the action. Device-local approval remains mandatory.

tools.name: light_remote_semantic_select
tools.title: Desktop semantic select
tools.description: Select a named semantic UI option (Windows UIA). This tool performs only this named operation. Optional await observes one declared UI state after the action. Device-local approval remains mandatory.

tools.name: light_remote_semantic_expand
tools.title: Desktop semantic expand
tools.description: Expand a named semantic UI node (Windows UIA). This tool performs only this named operation. Optional await observes one declared UI state after the action. Device-local approval remains mandatory.

tools.name: light_remote_semantic_collapse
tools.title: Desktop semantic collapse
tools.description: Collapse a named semantic UI node (Windows UIA). This tool performs only this named operation. Optional await observes one declared UI state after the action. Device-local approval remains mandatory.

tools.name: light_remote_desktop_move
tools.title: Desktop move
tools.description: Move the pointer to one screen coordinate. This tool performs only this named OS operation, optionally followed by a bounded UI state observation. Device-local approval remains mandatory.

tools.name: light_remote_desktop_click
tools.title: Desktop click
tools.description: Click the OS pointer once or a bounded number of times, optionally at given coordinates. This tool performs only this named OS operation, optionally followed by a bounded UI state observation. Device-local approval remains mandatory.

tools.name: light_remote_desktop_scroll
tools.title: Desktop scroll
tools.description: Scroll the pointer wheel by a bounded signed delta. This tool performs only this named OS operation, optionally followed by a bounded UI state observation. Device-local approval remains mandatory.

tools.name: light_remote_desktop_drag
tools.title: Desktop drag
tools.description: Drag the OS pointer from an explicit starting point to an ending point. This tool performs only this named OS operation, optionally followed by a bounded UI state observation. Device-local approval remains mandatory.

tools.name: light_remote_desktop_type_text
tools.title: Desktop type text
tools.description: Type Unicode text using the native OS keyboard input. This tool performs only this named OS operation, optionally followed by a bounded UI state observation. Device-local approval remains mandatory.

tools.name: light_remote_desktop_write_text
tools.title: Desktop write text
tools.description: Write Unicode text into the focused application using native OS input. This tool performs only this named OS operation, optionally followed by a bounded UI state observation. Device-local approval remains mandatory.

tools.name: light_remote_desktop_press_key
tools.title: Desktop press key
tools.description: Press one native key with explicitly enumerated modifiers. This tool performs only this named OS operation, optionally followed by a bounded UI state observation. Device-local approval remains mandatory.

tools.name: light_remote_desktop_launch_app
tools.title: Desktop launch app
tools.description: Launch one installed macOS application by bundle identifier (macOS only). This tool performs only this named OS operation, optionally followed by a bounded UI state observation. Device-local approval remains mandatory.

tools.name: light_remote_job
tools.title: Read durable job status
tools.description: Read an existing job instead of repeating an operation.

tools.name: light_remote_output
tools.title: Read durable job output
tools.description: Read bounded stdout/stderr by byte offset.

tools.title: Desktop drag
tools.description: Drag the OS pointer from an explicit starting point to an ending point. This tool performs only this named OS operation, optionally followed by a bounded UI state observation. Device-local approval remains mandatory.

tools.name: light_remote_desktop_type_text
tools.title: Desktop type text
tools.description: Type Unicode text using the native OS keyboard input. This tool performs only this named OS operation, optionally followed by a bounded UI state observation. Device-local approval remains mandatory.

tools.name: light_remote_desktop_write_text
tools.title: Desktop write text
tools.description: Write Unicode text into the focused application using native OS input. This tool performs only this named OS operation, optionally followed by a bounded UI state observation. Device-local approval remains mandatory.

tools.name: light_remote_desktop_press_key
tools.title: Desktop press key
tools.description: Press one native key with explicitly enumerated modifiers. This tool performs only this named OS operation, optionally followed by a bounded UI state observation. Device-local approval remains mandatory.

tools.name: light_remote_desktop_launch_app
tools.title: Desktop launch app
tools.description: Launch one installed macOS application by bundle identifier (macOS only). This tool performs only this named OS operation, optionally followed by a bounded UI state observation. Device-local approval remains mandatory.

tools.name: light_remote_job
tools.title: Read durable job status
tools.description: Read an existing job instead of repeating an operation.

tools.name: light_remote_output
tools.title: Read durable job output
tools.description: Read bounded stdout/stderr by byte offset.
